purpose: Records what each in-repo SPL component actually implements of the pair-link and address-admission contract defined in proto/definition/. It lives in docs/ rather than under proto/definition/ deliberately: the definition gate treats any content change under proto/definition/ as a contract change requiring a bundle_semver increase, and a documentation refresh is not a contract change. Per-component revisions also go stale on every commit to those components, so coupling this record to the contract version would force meaningless bumps.
how_to_refresh: Re-derive every claim from the cited path:line evidence, update audited_revision to the component's current last-touching commit, and correct any claim whose status changed. Do not carry a claim forward without re-deriving it.
evidence_convention: Every claim carries status (confirmed | refuted | undetermined) and a repo-relative evidence pointer. A claim without both is not a finding.

components.gate_not_wired_reason: The relay is blind by construction and parses no pair-link at all, so no vector in this corpus exercises code it ships. Wiring it would require adding a pair-link parser to its test directory that tests nothing the relay runs.

claims.claim: The relay never reads, parses, stores, or forwards relayed frame payloads.
The relay contains no pair-link version byte handling; zero occurrences of 0x06 in relay/src/.
The relay implements the pair-window rendezvous mechanism, addressed by an opaque RK string it does not decode.

components.gate_not_wired_reason: No pair-link parser or emitter exists in this component; it emits a pairing URL rather than an encoded pair-link blob, so no vector applies.

claims.claim: Emits a pairing URL (https://<host>:<port>/pair?token=<nonce>) rather than an encoded pair-link blob; no Crockford encoding and no QR payload.
Contains no HKDF and no 0x06 handling, so it cannot participate in the pair-window mechanism.

DIVERGENCE — reads the pairing nonce from the JSON body, which proto/pairing.md:157 explicitly forbids: 'the single-use nonce travels as the token query parameter (lowercase hex), not in the JSON body'.

DIVERGENCE — rejects the spec-conformant request outright. The handler compares the full request target for exact equality against '/pair', and that target includes the query string, so any '?token=' request 404s. The component therefore accepts only the form the specification forbids and refuses the form it requires.
DIVERGENCE — the pairing URL this component mints is 404'd by its own pairing server, so the reference implementation cannot pair with itself.

components.gate_not_wired_reason: This component holds the only pair-link parser in the repository and covers the 0x04/0x05 forms that a majority of the corpus exercises. Whether it passes those vectors is an open, untested question and adopting the corpus here is the most valuable next step — it is deliberately deferred to its own change rather than bundled into the corpus landing.

claims.claim: Parses pair-link form 0x03 and throws on any version outside 0x03/0x04/0x05, including 0x06.

DIVERGENCE — the 0x03 relay-pairing path is retired. proto/pair-window.md:3 declares a hard cutover to the 0x06 home-opened pairing window with no 0x03 or TOTP fallback, and proto/pairing.md contains no 0x03 layout.
DIVERGENCE — posts a TOTP to /session/pair-ticket, an endpoint the relay does not route, so this path cannot complete against this repository's own relay.
Contains no HKDF, so it cannot derive the pair-window relay key even if 0x06 parsing were added.

repository_level_findings.finding: No component in this repository parses or emits pair-link form 0x06. The mechanism is specified in proto/pair-window.md and implemented on the rendezvous side by the relay, but the encoded form itself has no in-repo producer or consumer.

No component in this repository implements HKDF, so the RK derivation specified in proto/pair-window.md has no in-repo implementation. The relay's absence is correct by design — it only ever handles RK — but the client and home sides are gaps.

The end-to-end harness is not part of the local gate. 'integration-test' is not a dependency of 'ci', and this repository contains no CI workflow directory, so the Makefile is the entire gate surface. The harness also cannot currently pass: it drives the home-minted pairing URL, which the home pairing server 404s.

scope_and_impact.these_are_reference_implementations: The relay is production. The home and mobile components in this repository are reference/example implementations, not shipped software. mobile/README.md describes itself as an example CLI that exercises the protocol end-to-end.
scope_and_impact.owner_impact: None. Every client that ships to a person implements the current pair-window form (0x06) and the HKDF relay-key derivation: the Swift shared package, the Android client, the Windows client, the browser extension, and the Rust shared package. The shipping home side also accepts the specification-conformant query-parameter nonce. The divergences below are confined to this repository's reference components.
what_it_does_cost: The example client is advertised as the wire-format reference for a downstream build, so a reader following it gets a retired mechanism.
The end-to-end harness drives the example client and therefore cannot pass, and it is not part of the local gate. The result is that this repository has no working end-to-end protocol test.
The relay's pair-window path has no in-repo client counterpart that derives the relay key from the pairing nonce the way a real client does; relay coverage uses synthesized keys.
scope_and_impact.partial_mitigation: The conformance corpus in proto/definition/ now pins the 0x06 pair-link forms and the relay-key derivation as vectors, including a published-fixture vector carrying a known nonce and its derived key. A new implementation therefore has machine-checkable truth in this repository even though the reference code here is stale.
